shared_visual_grammar.mobile_legibility: central action or consequence must remain legible

candidates.scene: A neutral tabletop physical system has several identical tokens or channels moving toward destinations. One human hand moves a simple central diverter and several downstream tokens or channels are visibly redirected together.
candidates.must_show: One action changes a multi-element external outcome rather than the actor's own route.

candidates.scene: A simple physical tabletop model contains several neutral paths or markers converging on a shared destination. A hand moves one central route or priority piece and the visible geometry changes the route for several markers at once.
candidates.must_show: External or shared direction changes because of one consequential intervention.

candidates.scene: A partially assembled neutral system has several branches currently inactive. One hand places a single plain connector or component and several branches visibly become connected or operational as one system.
candidates.must_show: The contribution changes what the larger system can do beyond the person's private task.

candidates.scene: Two hands measure a plain mechanical or wooden component with a simple caliper and align it precisely with a matching part. The fit or tolerance is visually clear.
candidates.must_show: Deliberate measurement and refinement toward accurate fit.

candidates.scene: Hands carefully refine a plain wooden joint or simple material edge using a hand tool. One area visibly shows rough-to-finished improvement within the same object.

A hand adjusts a simple neutral physical mechanism against a visible non-textual alignment reference, with an earlier imperfect alignment and the current precise alignment physically legible in the scene.
candidates.must_show: Controlled improvement through adjustment or practice rather than generic tool use.

candidates.scene: A neutral storage or work area has one newly accessible open section containing a clearly usable ordinary resource, tool or material that was previously inaccessible. A hand is positioned to take or use it and only one meaningful route is presented.
candidates.must_show: The opening provides usable future value rather than freedom or mystery.
avoid: dramatic light from an open door

candidates.scene: A simple neutral system or workspace shows a previously full or unavailable capacity with one clearly open usable slot now available, alongside a plain item ready to occupy or use that slot.
candidates.must_show: An actionable capacity or opening that can improve the next state.

candidates.scene: A neutral physical process has one now-open gateway revealing a clearly visible next-stage capability or resource beyond it. The route is already enabled, there are no alternative paths, and the benefit beyond the gateway is concrete and ordinary rather than mysterious.
candidates.must_show: Access to a useful next stage rather than exploration of an unknown space.
